why: On November 20, 2026, Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini under an Apache 2.0 license, introducing a 26.4-billion-parameter looped Mixture-of-Experts architecture whose 12 middle layers run three times per token. Small enough to run locally on laptops while leading sub-100B open-weight models on DeepSWE v1.1 (48.2%) and Vals Index v2.2 (46.5%), it gives developers a direct test of looped-transformer reasoning efficiency and adds a fresh open-source release to recent blog coverage.

set_aside.why: Levent Alpöge's Claude-assisted Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis was verified to compile by two groups, but broader mathematical peer review of the 239 MB formalization is just beginning.
The House committees' 12 policy recommendations on Chinese open-weight models and Anysphere's statement that it plans to explore phasing them out carry no immediate binding federal ban yet.
